title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 7.35
exact_target: Given a real function of bounded mean oscillation, determine the smallest possible size of its bounded conjugate component in a bounded-plus-conjugate decomposition.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2307035 (AMR-022-7035). CC BY4.0.
